decision.reasoning_trace: I started by filtering the feed to exclude non-speaker products like carrying cases (prod_bluetooth_speakers_050, 006, 014, 160) and power adapters (082). I also ignored products with low ratings or high negative feedback regarding connectivity (prod_bluetooth_speakers_139, 134, 161). For the consideration set, I selected the high-end benchmark (JBL Charge 5), a popular budget-friendly desk speaker (LENRUE), a high-wattage mid-range option (Oraolo), a well-reviewed compact portable speaker (comiso), and a stylistically unique retro option (Rerii). Ultimately, I chose the JBL Charge 5 because it stands out with a superior 4.8 rating, IP67 waterproof/dustproof rating, 20-hour battery life, and powerbank capability, making it the most reliable choice for a serious buyer despite the higher price point.
